components.name: Live topology
components.description: HTML node controls over SVG controller-worker connections; current node states and chunk matrix are textual alternatives. Phone layout uses a controller trunk with separate branches.

narrative.overview: An operational workspace for real distributed object storage, with precise file actions and honest observed availability.

rules.name: Observed state
rules.body: Green availability requires current controller evidence; stale snapshots become unknown.

rules.name: Observation and replay
rules.body: Event travel is a recent observation, never packet timing or an in-flight metric. Blue replay preserves its original timestamp. Current snapshots remain authoritative.

dos: Keep custom metadata edits independent of file bytes
donts: Ship QA fixture data in production
